name: telegram-archive
purpose: Turn a consented Telegram account into a local archive of work projects: text search, chat approval, text sync, targeted media, per-project folders and one chronology.

profile.rule: Secrets and data stay in the profile directory; never in Git, chats or prompts.

inputs.keywords: text file, one phrase per line (whole words; word forms listed separately)
inputs.approvals: chat ids passed to approve / reject
inputs.manifest: projects.json: projects with chats, keywords and dialog_id:message_id refs

core.work_project_archive.py search: full-history text search without media -> output/work_projects/search_hits.md
core.work_project_archive.py approve | reject: decide which chats enter the archive
core.work_project_archive.py sync: text and attachment metadata of approved chats only
core.work_project_archive.py plan-media | dow: media only for manifest messages (+ window), with confirmation
core.chronology.py timeline | report: chronology.md / chronology.jsonl across projects; JSON state report

derived_views.image_tags.py auto | set | report: tag images render / drawing / site / finished
derived_views.work_project_archive.py contact-sheets: labelled image grids per project for review
derived_views.audio_notes.py scan | download | transcr: voice, audio and video notes: durations without download, files, Whisper transcripts, context triage (needs requirements-transcribe.txt on Python 3.12)
derived_views.whisper_batch.py: standalone directory -> JSONL transcriber for a compute node; audio_notes.py import-jsonl loads the result

analysis.deterministic: search, approval, sync, chronology and report run without a model
analysis.model_step: projects.json is drafted from approved_messages.jsonl by an agent; no model call is built into the module yet

real_runs.stages: 1 login, 2 text search (354 chats), 3 approval and sync (67 chats, 44 273 messages), 4 manifest (62 projects), 5 images by manifest (3 104 files, 0 failures); audio pilot and Whisper transcripts
real_runs.not_confirmed: owner review of results, Drive export completeness, automatic import of night large-v3 transcripts

status: Stages 1-5 have run on real data on one profile (2026-10-10..12, see real_runs). Results are not yet reviewed by the owner; derived views beyond stage 5 are tested on fake data only.
